page.content:
Interstellar union Starfleet serves.

How United Federation of Planets connects

  • Faction: Starfleet — Starfleet is the service arm of the Federation.
  • Location: Earth — The Federation's human capital sits on Earth.
  • Faction: Romulan Star Empire — Romulans face the Federation across the Neutral Zone.

What is United Federation of Planets?

The United Federation of Planets is the multi-world government of humans, Vulcans, and later members, the political home of Starfleet's exploratory charter.

Key threads lead to Starfleet, Earth and Romulan Star Empire.
